rules.title: UI primitives (components/ui) are the bottom layer: they may use lib and hooks only, never pages, contexts, integrations or other components
rules.suggestion: pass what the primitive needs in as props

rules.title: a component must not import a page: pages sit above components
rules.suggestion: move the shared piece down into components/ (or lib/) and import it from there in both places

rules.title: lib/ (shared helpers) must not import components, pages, contexts or hooks
rules.suggestion: pass data in as arguments; move UI-dependent helpers next to the component that uses them

rules.title: hooks must not import components or pages: data logic does not depend on the UI
rules.suggestion: return data or callbacks and let the component render them

rules.title: contexts and the Supabase integration must not import components, pages or hooks
rules.suggestion: contexts expose state; hooks and components read it, never the reverse

rules.title: components and pages must not import the Supabase client: data access goes through hooks (or a context)
rules.suggestion: add or reuse a use*.ts hook in src/hooks/ that wraps the query and call that

rules.title: the browser app must not import edge-function code: they are separate deployables (Vite/browser vs Deno)
rules.suggestion: share a contract (request/response types, the database), not code

rules.title: an edge function must not import the browser app: it runs in Deno on the server, with different libraries and secrets
rules.suggestion: duplicate the few types you need, or call the database

forbiddenPatterns.message: the browser writes a billing, plan, coupon, role or audit table directly: money and permissions are decided on the server (an edge function with the service key, or an admin-only RLS policy), never trusted from the client
forbiddenPatterns.suggestion: call the matching edge function (razorpay-*, validate-coupon, admin-*) instead of writing the table from the app

forbiddenPatterns.message: the service-role key (or its name) appears in code that ships to the browser: it bypasses all row-level security
forbiddenPatterns.suggestion: keep it in an edge function (Deno.env) only; the app uses the anon/publishable key

forbiddenPatterns.message: a live Razorpay key id is written in the code
forbiddenPatterns.suggestion: read it from the environment (Deno.env in functions; never in the browser bundle)

forbiddenPatterns.message: a payment secret name appears in browser code: payment secrets must stay in the edge functions
forbiddenPatterns.suggestion: verify payments in razorpay-verify-payment / razorpay-webhook, never in the app

forbiddenPatterns.message: a token, secret or password is stored in localStorage, readable by any script on the page (XSS)
forbiddenPatterns.suggestion: let the Supabase client manage the session; never store credentials yourself
